dialog.english:
Is this... the Village of
Beginnings?
dialog.translation:
¿Es esto... la Ciudad de
los Bebés?

dialog.english: We're back!

Hey, the village is back to
normal!
dialog.translation:
¡La Ciudad ha vuelto a la
normalidad!

dialog.english:
Whoa, there's so many DigiEggs
everywhere!
Hey, wait for me!

Now all the dead Digimon can be
reborn...
dialog.translation:
Los Digimon muertos podrán
renacer ya...

dialog.english: Thank goodness...

And so ends the prophecy inscribed
in the ancient ruins...
dialog.translation:
Y así acaba la profecía
escrita en las ruinas
antiguas...

dialog.english:
First, what returned was the
island, and that island created a
new sky and sea and land...
dialog.translation:
Primero volvió la isla,
y esa isla creó un
nuevo cielo, mar y tierra...

dialog.english: So what does that mean?

In other words, the Digimon world
is being recreated.
dialog.translation:
En otras palabras, el
Digimundo se está
recreando.

dialog.english:
Shall we take a photo to
commemorate the occasion,
everyone?
dialog.translation:
¿Nos hacemos una foto
para conmemorar la
ocasión, chicos?

dialog.english: A picture? Why not?
Good idea!
I agree!
Talk to me whenever you are ready!
Okay!
Then I shall take the picture.
Please do!
Ready, guys?
Say cheese!
Aaaaah!
What happened?
It hatched!
How cute!
So you're leaving, no matter what?
dialog.translation: ¿Así que te vas, pase lo que pase?

dialog.english:
I'm proud to be a Virus-type,
y'know! Vaccine and Data-types
like y'all make my stomach turn!
dialog.translation:
¡Yo estoy orgulloso de ser tipo
Virus! Vosotros, ¡los tipo Vacuna
y Datos, me dais asco!

dialog.english: All right, see ya!
...He left.
He's just trying to look cool...
Oh, how nostalgic!

This is where we spent our first
night in this world!
dialog.translation:
¡Aquí pasamos nuestra
primera noche en este
mundo!

dialog.english:
Man, a lot's happened since we
came here, but I'm really glad we
did.
dialog.translation:
Vaya, han pasado muchas
cosas desde que llegamos,
pero me alegro.

dialog.english:
We won't have any regrets going
home!
dialog.translation:
¡No nos arrepentimos de
volver a casa!

dialog.english: Joe...

Oh. Oh, no. I shouldn't have said
that...
Hey...
What?

We still have quite a bit of
summer break left...
dialog.translation:
Todavía nos queda
bastante verano por
delante...

dialog.english:
I think I'll stay here for the
rest of it.
dialog.translation:
Me quedaré aquí el resto
de vacaciones.

dialog.english: Oh, good idea!
I'll stay here if Matt does!
dialog.translation: ¡Yo me quedo si se queda Matt!

dialog.english: Me, too! Is that okay, Tai?
Yeah!
I'd like to do so as well.
Me, too!
Me, too! We've got tons of time!

Indeed. If one day here is
equivalent to one second in our
world...
dialog.translation:
Cierto. Si un día aquí
equivale a un segundo en
nuestro mundo...

dialog.english:
I can do it in my head! Uh... Four
thousand and thirty-two days. So
about a hundred and ten years!
dialog.translation:
¡Puedo calcularlo de cabeza!
Emm... cuatro mil treinta y dos
días. ¡Unos ciento diez años!

dialog.english: Seriously?!

That's great! We can go on another
adventure!
Yeah!

All right, let's go! Our new
adventure starts now!
...Huh?
It's a solar eclipse...

Children, I've got some news for
you about that eclipse.
dialog.translation:
Niños, tengo noticias
sobre ese eclipse.

dialog.english: Good news or bad news?
...Probably bad news.

But it's just a solar eclipse,
isn't it?
dialog.translation:
Pero solo es un eclipse
solar, ¿no?

dialog.english:
The eclipse's shadow is the gate
to your world.
dialog.translation:
La sombra del eclipse es
la puerta a vuestro mundo.

dialog.english:
The eclipse will end in around two
hours.
dialog.translation:
El eclipse terminará en
unas dos horas.

dialog.english:
Then why don't we just wait for
the next gate?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué no esperamos a la
próxima puerta?

dialog.english:
Yeah! After all, we've got a
hundred and ten years left of
summer break!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Al fin y al cabo, nos
quedan ciento diez años
de vacaciones!

dialog.english:
But that was because of
Apocalymon...

Now, the flow of time in your
world and our world is the same.
dialog.translation:
Ahora el tiempo pasa igual
en vuestro mundo y en el
nuestro.

dialog.english: What?!
So what happens if we stay?
Matt...

This world may consider you
foreign objects and delete your
data.
dialog.translation:
Este mundo podría veros
como intrusos y borrar
vuestros datos.

dialog.english: So...
Unfortunately...

When you get back, take care of
your mom.
dialog.translation:
Cuando vuelvas, cuida de
tu madre.

dialog.english:
Yeah... And besides, I need to
thank you, Piyomon...
dialog.translation:
Sí... además, debo darte
las gracias, Piyomon...

dialog.english:
My mom and I were having a hard
time seeing eye-to-eye, but I
think we'll fix it because of you.
dialog.translation:
Mi madre y yo no nos entendíamos
muy bien, pero creo que lo
arreglaremos gracias a ti.

dialog.english:
I think we'll be able to get along
fine from now on.
dialog.translation:
Creo que a partir de ahora
nos llevaremos bien.

dialog.english: Really?
Really!

I'm so happy to hear that, Sora! I
was worried that maybe I was
always bothering you...
dialog.translation:
¡Me alegra mucho oír eso,
Sora! Temía estar siendo
una molestia para ti...

dialog.english:
Of course not! Not at all!
Piyomon...
Piyomon...

Okay, we might not have
necessarily been the best fighting
duo, but...
dialog.translation:
Vale, puede que no fuéramos
el mejor dúo de combate,
pero...

dialog.english: ...It was still pretty fun.

I think so too! And by the way,
good luck on your studies when you
get home.
dialog.translation:
¡Yo también lo creo! Y
suerte con los estudios
cuando vuelvas.

dialog.english: Yeah?
What?
Let's shake hands.
Huh? ...Okay, why not.
...huh!
What?
So you *do* have hands!
Tentomon...
Izzy...
I... am... truly thankful to you.
dialog.translation: Yo... te lo agradezco de veras.

dialog.english: Oi, oi, oi!

You're always bein' so formal and
polite with me, Izzy, even
now...
dialog.translation:
Siempre eres tan formal y
educado conmigo, Izzy,
incluso ahora...

dialog.english:
S-Sorry. But then what should I
say at a time like this?
dialog.translation:
L-Lo siento. ¿Pero qué se
dice en un momento así?

dialog.english:
Well, it's hard to say, but... you
shouldn't be forcin' yourself.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, es difícil de decir,
pero... no deberías
forzarte.

dialog.english:
No problem bein' all formal if
that's the way you wanna say it.
dialog.translation:
No pasa nada si quieres
hablar así de formal.

dialog.english:
Well, the words'll come easy to
you someday.
dialog.translation:
Ya te saldrán las palabras
más fácil un día.

dialog.english: Do you think so? I hope so...
Waaaaaaah! Waaaaaaaah!
Waaaaaaaah... Don't cry, T.K...

Waaaaaaah... But... But... we
won't be able to see each other
again...
dialog.translation:
Buaaaaa... Pero... pero...
no podremos volver a
vernos...

dialog.english:
That's not true...
Your world and my world run
on the same time...
dialog.translation:
Eso no es verdad...
Tu mundo y el mío van
al mismo ritmo...

dialog.english: ...so we'll meet again sometime!
Really?

That's how it was with Devimon,
right?

Yeah, I really believed we'd meet
again...
dialog.translation:
Sí, creía que nos
volveríamos a ver...

dialog.english: So believe again!

Okay! We'll meet again. It's a
promise!
Yeah!
...Hey, Matt...
...Yeah?

Can you play your harmonica for me
again?
...Sure.
...Sure.
...Are you serious, Matt?!
What's wrong?
...No, it's nothing.

Hey, this was where I lit a fire
with my Baby Flame, isn't it?
dialog.translation:
Oye, aquí fue donde encendí
un fuego con mi Llama
Bebé, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Yeah! Matt got mad because it
scorched his clothes.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Matt se enfadó porque
le quemó la ropa.

dialog.english: ...Huh? Was it my fault?

Wait, no, it's because I was
teasing Gabumon. Hahaha!
dialog.translation:
No, fue porque estaba
molestando a Gabumon.
¡Jajaja!

dialog.english: Taiiiiii!
Ahaha... ah... *sob*
Haha... *sob*
...Are you sure?
Yeah.
...Thanks.
Looks good on you.

Really? Okay so... take care,
Kari.
Until next time.
Next time?
Next time.
Palmon! Palmooooooon!
Whatcha doin', ribbit?

I can't find Palmon. Have you seen
her?
dialog.translation:
No encuentro a Palmon. ¿La
has visto?

dialog.english: We haven't, ribbit.

Really? Where did Palmon go... We
don't have much time left...
dialog.translation:
¿En serio? ¿Dónde se habrá
metido...? Nos queda poco
tiempo...

dialog.english:
We've completed modifications to
the trolley. We're ready to go at 
any time.
dialog.translation:
Hemos terminado de arreglar el
tranvía. Podemos salir cuando
queráis.

dialog.english: Okay! Good job!

Come talk to me when you're done
saying your farewells.
dialog.translation:
Venid a hablar conmigo cuando
acabéis de despediros.

dialog.english: Got it, old man!
Indeed!

Have you finished saying your
farewells? We've finished on our
end.
dialog.translation:
¿Habéis acabado de
despediros? Por nuestra
parte, ya está listo.

dialog.english: Well...
Can't we have a little more time?
dialog.translation: ¿Nos das un poco más de tiempo?

dialog.english:
No can do. The gate won't be
waiting.
dialog.translation:
Imposible. La puerta no
va a esperar.

dialog.english: But...
What's wrong?
Palmon's gone.

Palmon... Stupid, stupid, stupid
Palmon...
Mimi...
Ah! There you are, ribbit!

Mimi's been looking for you,
ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Mimi te ha estado
buscando, croac.

dialog.english: I know... I don't want to see her.
Why not, ribbit?

If I see her, it's going to hurt
even more when she leaves! So it's
better if we don't...
dialog.translation:
¡Si la veo, dolerá aún más
cuando se vaya! Es mejor
no verla...

dialog.english:
Are you sure you're okay with
that, ribbit?
dialog.translation:
¿Segura que estás bien
con eso, croac?

dialog.english: Are you *really* sure, ribbit?

You're not gonna regret it,
ribbit?

We're out of time. Please board
the trolley.
dialog.translation:
Se acaba el tiempo. Subid
al tranvía.

dialog.english: All right, guys. Take care!
You too, Tai!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Mimi!
Mimi!
Yeah!
Mimi! I'm sorry!

It's fine! Thank you, Palmon!
Goodbye!
Mimi! Ack!
Ah!

And for all eight of them, that
was the end of their summer
vacation...
dialog.translation:
Y así, para los ocho,
terminaron sus vacaciones
de verano...

dialog.english:
However, the gate would not stay
closed forever.
dialog.translation:
Pero la puerta no seguiría
cerrada para siempre.

dialog.english:
Nor would this be the first - or
last - of the Chosen Children's
adventures.
dialog.translation:
Ni sería esta la primera -
ni la última - aventura de
los Niños Elegidos.

dialog.english:
The gate to the Digimon world
will surely open again...
dialog.translation:
La puerta al Digimundo
seguro que se abrirá de
nuevo...

dialog.english:
And as long as you do not forget
the Digimon, if you wish for it,
then within your heart...
dialog.translation:
Y mientras no olvidéis a
los Digimon, si lo deseáis,
en vuestro corazón...

dialog.english: Or, perhaps...
Sure! Take a commemorative photo.
Just a bit longer, please.

We're ready to take the
commemorative photo at any time. 
Are you done talking to everyone?
dialog.translation:
Estamos listos para la foto de
recuerdo cuando queráis. ¿Ya
hablasteis con todos?

dialog.english:
Understood! Then I shall call
everyone here.

Whenever you're ready, come speak
to me.
dialog.translation:
Cuando estéis listos,
venid a hablarme.

dialog.english:
This village is gonna be full of
babies when these eggs hatch!
dialog.translation:
¡Este pueblo se llenará de
bebés cuando eclosionen
los huevos!

dialog.english: I bet!
You're gonna be busy!

With this many eggs? No doubt
about it!

All right, I'm gonna have to get
down to work!
dialog.translation:
¡Bueno, me pongo manos a
la obra!

dialog.english:
Which one of these eggs is
Leomon's? Nah, there's no way I 
can recognize it.
dialog.translation:
¿Cuál de estos huevos será
el de Leomon? Nah, no hay
forma de saberlo.

dialog.english:
Isn't it a little early to be
worrying about that?
dialog.translation:
¿No es un poco pronto para
preocuparte por eso?

dialog.english:
He gets lonely if Leomon's not
around.
dialog.translation:
Se pone triste sin Leomon
cerca.

dialog.english: S-Shut up!

Which one of these eggs is
Leomon's...

So what are you gonna do now,
Centarumon?
dialog.translation:
¿Y ahora qué vas a hacer,
Centarumon?

dialog.english:
I will return to the ruins and
watch over this world's
reconstruction...
dialog.translation:
Volveré a las ruinas y
vigilaré la reconstrucción
de este mundo...

dialog.english:
so that peace may return to File
Island and the surrounding
continents.
dialog.translation:
para que la paz vuelva a la
Isla File y a los
continentes vecinos.

dialog.english:
We're the ones who brought that
peaceful world back, aren't we...
dialog.translation:
Nosotros fuimos quienes
trajimos esa paz de vuelta,
¿no?

dialog.english:
Yes, it was thanks to you. You are
welcome to visit at any time.
dialog.translation:
Gracias a vosotros. Podéis
venir cuando queráis.

dialog.english: Yeah! We'll drop by for sure!

I'm truly thankful for everything
you've done for us.
dialog.translation:
Os estoy muy agradecido
por todo lo que habéis
hecho.

dialog.english:
Hey, old man Gennai! What's with
the huge frown?
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, viejo Gennai! ¿Por qué
esa cara de enfado?

dialog.english:
It's been a while since I've taken
a picture. I'm practicing my
smile!
dialog.translation:
Hace tiempo que no me hago
fotos. ¡Estoy practicando
mi sonrisa!

dialog.english:
Wait, what? You look like you're
really mad.

Old man Gennai's got a scary
smile...
dialog.translation:
El viejo Gennai tiene una
sonrisa que da miedo...

dialog.english: Really now? Oh ho ho.

It's been a while since I've taken
a picture. Oh ho ho...
dialog.translation:
Hace tiempo que no me hago
fotos. Ji ji ji...

dialog.english:
You don't have any lingering
regrets, do you?
We're ready.
Give us a bit more time...

All right. Bring everyone here,
then.
dialog.translation:
Bien. Traed a todos aquí,
pues.

dialog.english:
When you're done saying your
farewells, come talk to me.
dialog.translation:
Cuando acabéis de
despediros, venid a
hablar conmigo.

dialog.english: Hey, Matt!
Oh hey, it's Tai!

This place is always packed.
What's going on today?
dialog.translation:
Este sitio siempre está
lleno. ¿Qué pasa hoy?

dialog.english:
Oh, there's a band coming from
overseas. They're having a
concert.
dialog.translation:
Ah, viene un grupo de
fuera del país. Van a dar
un concierto.

dialog.english:
Wait, so you're going to a
concert?
dialog.translation:
Espera, ¿vas a ir a un
concierto?

dialog.english:
Yeah, I've been a fan for a while.
I'm thinking of picking up the
bass, too.
dialog.translation:
Sí, soy fan desde hace
tiempo. Estoy pensando en
aprender a tocar el bajo.

dialog.english: Really? Do you have a band yet?
No, I'm still working on that...

Yeah... you're pretty bad at
dealing with other people.
dialog.translation:
Ya... se te da fatal lo
de tratar con la gente.

dialog.english: Tai, are you insulting me?

You know, we never managed to
settle the score for real when we
were in the Digital World!
dialog.translation:
¡Oye, nunca llegamos a
saldar cuentas de verdad
en el Digimundo!

dialog.english: Okay, wanna go? With what?
Soccer? Cooking? Karaoke?

There's probably more important
stuff than just that...
dialog.translation:
Seguramente hay cosas más
importantes que eso...

dialog.english:
You really don't get it, do you?
Nah, forget about it.
dialog.translation:
De verdad no lo pillas,
¿no? Nah, déjalo.

dialog.english:
Hey! Why are you talking to
yourself all of a sudden?

Oh, quiet down. I gotta go, so see
you later.
dialog.translation:
Calla ya. Me tengo que ir,
nos vemos.

dialog.english: Yeah! Have fun at the concert!

I have no idea what Matt was
going on about...
dialog.translation:
No tengo ni idea de qué
iba Matt...

dialog.english: Tai!
Hey, Sora! What's up?

Taking care of some errands. What
about you?

Forget me! Are you seriously
quitting soccer?
dialog.translation:
¡Olvídate de mí! ¿De verdad vas
a dejar el fútbol?

dialog.english:
Sorry, I thought I might try out
some other stuff, like tennis.
dialog.translation:
Perdona, pensé en probar
otras cosas, como el tenis.

dialog.english:
Tennis? That doesn't suit you at
all! Come back to soccer!
dialog.translation:
¿Tenis? ¡Eso no te pega
nada! ¡Vuelve al fútbol!

dialog.english:
It's fine! I'm trying to change my
image. Like maybe taking off the
hat and trying on skirts...
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilo! Quiero cambiar
de imagen. Como quitarme
la gorra y probar faldas...

dialog.english:
Think maybe it'd be better if I
didn't? Would that suit me better?
dialog.translation:
¿Crees que sería mejor no
hacerlo? ¿Me quedaría mejor
así?

dialog.english:
Does it really matter? This way,
that way, they're both fine,
aren't they?
dialog.translation:
¿Eso importa de verdad? Así
o asá, las dos están bien,
¿no?

dialog.english:
Ugh, it was stupid to think you'd
have anything useful to say... I'm
going home.
dialog.translation:
Uf, fue una tontería pensar
que dirías algo útil...
Me voy a casa.

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora! Why'd you get angry all
of a sudden? I don't get it!
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, Sora! ¿Por qué te has
enfadado de repente? ¡No lo
entiendo!

dialog.english: Hey, Izzy!
Hello, Tai!

You haven't been coming over
lately. Did something happen?
dialog.translation:
Últimamente no vienes por
aquí. ¿Ha pasado algo?

dialog.english:
I've been looking into some things
related to the Myotismon incident.
dialog.translation:
He estado investigando
cosas sobre el incidente
de Myotismon.

dialog.english:
Seems like it's had an effect on
both the Digital World and the
real world.
dialog.translation:
Parece que ha afectado
tanto al Digimundo como
al mundo real.

dialog.english: So you can't come over?

Well, I could, but... I've been
stuck to my computer more than I
was before.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, podría, pero...
paso más tiempo pegado al
ordenador que antes.

dialog.english:
You're looking into the Digital
World, right?

Yes. The battle with Apocalymon
had a great impact on the world...
dialog.translation:
Sí. La batalla contra
Apocalymon tuvo gran
impacto en el mundo...

dialog.english:
People all over the world have
begun to look into that incident.
dialog.translation:
Gente de todo el mundo ha
empezado a investigar ese
incidente.

dialog.english: And you're one of them, right?
dialog.translation: Y tú eres uno de ellos, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Yes, although of course I've kept
our adventure a secret.
dialog.translation:
Sí, aunque he mantenido
nuestra aventura en
secreto.

dialog.english:
Right now, I'm enjoying myself
exchanging emails with people all
over the world.
dialog.translation:
Ahora mismo disfruto
intercambiando correos con
gente de todo el mundo.

dialog.english:
Huh! I didn't think you'd say
that, Izzy!
Please don't make fun of me!

I mean, when we were at camp, you
had this really bad expression on
your face whenever we went to bed.
dialog.translation:
Es que en el campamento ponías
una cara horrible cada vez que
nos íbamos a dormir.

dialog.english: Yes, you might be right.
Right?

I think I simply felt a sense of
distance from everyone.
dialog.translation:
Creo que simplemente
sentía distancia de todos.

dialog.english: So that's all it was.
Ah! I've received another email!

Well, if something happens in the
Digital World, tell me as soon as
you can.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, si pasa algo en el
Digimundo, avísame en
cuanto puedas.

dialog.english: Of course!
Mimi!
Tai!

Wow, someone's carrying a lot. Did
you go shopping?
dialog.translation:
Vaya, menuda carga. ¿Has
ido de compras?

dialog.english:
I bought all the clothes that I've
wanted since we got back! And
more!
dialog.translation:
¡Me he comprado toda la
ropa que quería desde que
volvimos! ¡Y más!

dialog.english:
I know, but you gotta draw the
line somewhere...
dialog.translation:
Pero hay que poner un
límite en algún sitio...

dialog.english: I haven't hit that line yet!

Well, today's clothes are lookin'
good today, princess!
dialog.translation:
¡Bueno, hoy la ropa te
queda genial, princesa!

dialog.english: Hey, don't call me "princess"!

...Hey, you seem to be doing just
fine.

You know... we had a lot of fun,
but a lot of really sad things
happened too...
dialog.translation:
Ya sabes... nos lo pasamos
muy bien, pero también
pasaron cosas muy tristes...

dialog.english:
I kept getting upset because of 
all the bad things that happened 
to the Digimon who fought for us.
dialog.translation:
Me disgustaba mucho todo lo malo
que les pasaba a los Digimon que
luchaban por nosotros.

dialog.english: Yeah...

I guess I'm becoming more like an
adult, huh?
dialog.translation:
Supongo que me estoy
haciendo más adulta, ¿no?

dialog.english:
I remember you were always saying
stuff along the lines of "I'm
hungry!"
dialog.translation:
Recuerdo que siempre
decías cosas como
"¡Tengo hambre!"

dialog.english: Hey, don't say that!

Papa and Mama are calling me! See
you later, Tai!
dialog.translation:
¡Papá y mamá me llaman!
¡Nos vemos, Tai!

dialog.english: Yeah, see you later!
Tai!
Joe! Coming back from cram school?

Man, my grades have been going
down ever since we got back from
the Digital World...
dialog.translation:
Uf, mis notas no dejan de
bajar desde que volvimos
del Digimundo...

dialog.english:
Dad scolded me to death and Mom
started crying. It's been bad.
dialog.translation:
Papá me echó la bronca y
mamá se puso a llorar.
Fue horrible.

dialog.english:
That's the life of a student who
lives his life by exams, I
guess...
dialog.translation:
Así es la vida de un
estudiante que vive por
exámenes, supongo...

dialog.english: Well, it hasn't been that bad.
dialog.translation: Bueno, no ha sido tan malo.

dialog.english: Huh?!

Maybe I've built some tolerance in 
the Digital World. I don't faint 
at the sight of blood anymore.
dialog.translation:
Puede que me haya endurecido en
el Digimundo. Ya no me desmayo al
ver sangre.

dialog.english:
At least, not unless I were losing
blood from anemia.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, salvo que sea por
perder sangre de la anemia.

dialog.english:
Hey, you're making progress!
You'll be a great doctor, Joe.
dialog.translation:
¡Eh, estás progresando!
Serás un gran médico, Joe.

dialog.english:
We've all changed a lot ever since
we got back from the Digital
World!
dialog.translation:
¡Todos hemos cambiado
mucho desde que volvimos
del Digimundo!

dialog.english:
I thought I hadn't, so I was
really surprised.
dialog.translation:
Pensaba que yo no, y me
sorprendió mucho.

dialog.english:
Hey, whaddya mean by that? Of
course you're changed.
dialog.translation:
Eh, ¿qué quieres decir?
Claro que has cambiado.

dialog.english: You think so? In what way?

You're a lot more reliable than
you were before!
Yeah, yeah!

Looks like I'll really have to
treat you like my senior!
dialog.translation:
¡Parece que voy a tener que
tratarte como a un mayor!

dialog.english: Right, Mr. Kido?
Hey, Tai! Don't make fun of me!
Sorry, sorry!

Oops! We've been talking for too
long. I don't wanna keep my tutor
waiting!
dialog.translation:
¡Uy! Hemos hablado demasiado.
¡No quiero hacer esperar a
mi profesor!

dialog.english: Wait, you're *still* studying?
See you later!
Joe! Good luck with your studies!
Hey, T.K!
Tai! Long time no see!
Are you visiting Matt's place?

Yeah! Mom's gonna be late at work,
so I'm gonna be eating dinner with
Matt and Dad!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Mamá llega tarde del
trabajo, así que ceno con
Matt y papá!

dialog.english:
Huh! Do you go to Matt's place
often?
No, not really!

Huh, that's surprising. So
Matt's okay with not seeing you
as much anymore...
dialog.translation:
Vaya, qué sorpresa. Así que
a Matt no le importa
verte menos ahora...

dialog.english:
That's not it, Tai! I'm grown
up now!

Hahaha! So Matt's not the one
who's grown up, it's you!
dialog.translation:
¡Jajaja! ¡Así que el que ha
crecido no es Matt, eres
tú!

dialog.english:
I thought I'd be lonely after
leaving Patamon...
dialog.translation:
Pensaba que me sentiría
solo sin Patamon...

dialog.english: But I'm okay now!

So what caused the change of
heart?
dialog.translation:
¿Y qué te hizo cambiar de
idea?

dialog.english:
Our hearts are connected, even if
we're reaaaaaaaally far apart!
dialog.translation:
¡Nuestros corazones están
unidos, aunque estemos
muuuuuy lejos!

dialog.english:
It's the same for me and Matt
and my dad!
dialog.translation:
¡Me pasa igual con Matt y
con papá!

dialog.english:
Yeah. That's how I feel about
Agumon, too...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Así me siento yo con
Agumon también...

dialog.english:
Ah! Matt's gonna be waiting for
me! I gotta go!
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! ¡Matt me está esperando!
¡Me tengo que ir!

dialog.english: Yeah! Take care of Matt!
You take care of Kari, too!
What are you looking at, Tai?

Our memorial picture! The one we
took with everyone! The old man
sent it to me by email.
dialog.translation:
¡Nuestra foto de recuerdo! ¡La que
nos hicimos todos! El viejo me la
mandó por correo.

dialog.english: It's been a while.

It all started when you and I met
a Koromon in Karigaoka...
dialog.translation:
Todo empezó cuando
conocimos a un Koromon en
Hikarioka...

dialog.english: You're right.

Hey, how come you remembered that
and I forgot?
dialog.translation:
Oye, ¿cómo es que tú te
acuerdas y yo no?

dialog.english:
So you've finally realized! I'm
actually psychic!
dialog.translation:
¡Por fin te das cuenta! ¡En
realidad soy vidente!

dialog.english: Hahaha... Very funny...

But honestly, I'm sure the gate to
the Digital World will open again.
dialog.translation:
Pero de verdad, seguro que
la puerta al Digimundo se
abrirá de nuevo.

dialog.english: Really?

Yeah! And until then, I'm going to
be training my body!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Y hasta entonces, voy
a entrenar mi cuerpo!

dialog.english:
Oh! We got an email! Who's it
from?
H-Hey! Stop it! Don't look!

It's from Sora, isn't it? I know
you two exchanged email addresses!
dialog.translation:
Es de Sora, ¿verdad? ¡Sé
que os disteis los correos!

dialog.english:
Kari! Have you been peeking at
my computer?

I have no idea what you're talking
about!
dialog.translation:
¡No tengo ni idea de qué
hablas!

dialog.english: Hey! You just wait right there!

Hey, Gabumon. Say goodbye to
Tai.

Yeah... hey, Tai, when you get
back, don't forget about us!
dialog.translation:
Sí... ¡oye, Tai, cuando
vuelvas, no te olvides de
nosotros!

dialog.english: Of course I won't!

And I'm sorry for pretending to
take off your pelt!
dialog.translation:
¡Y perdón por fingir que te
quitaba el pelaje!

dialog.english:
Aw... you don't have to apologize
for that, Tai!
dialog.translation:
Ay... ¡no hace falta que te
disculpes por eso, Tai!

dialog.english:
Really? Then next time, why don't
you show me what you look like
under there?
dialog.translation:
¿En serio? Entonces la
próxima vez, muéstrame
cómo eres por debajo.

dialog.english: Hey, Tai!
Pffffhahaha!
We'll meet again, right?

Thanks for all the times you
helped us, Tai!

I could say the same! Take care,
Piyomon!

Okay! And make sure you're getting
along with Sora.

Haha! You sounded like her mom
there just now.
dialog.translation:
¡Jaja! Ahora mismo sonabas
como su madre.

dialog.english:
Although you sound like a kid
whenever you go looking for her.
dialog.translation:
Aunque tú suenas como un
niño cuando vas a
buscarla.

dialog.english: He's right!
Ahaha...
And take care of Sora's mom, too.
dialog.translation: Cuida también de la madre de Sora.

dialog.english: Take care o' yourself, Tai!
You too, Tentomon!

Thanks for teaching us all kinds
of stuff about the Digital World!
dialog.translation:
¡Gracias por enseñarnos
tantas cosas sobre el
Digimundo!

dialog.english:
Whaddya mean by that? All I do is
just study stuff.
dialog.translation:
¿Qué quieres decir? Yo solo
me dedico a estudiar.

dialog.english:
If we had a school 'ere, I'd love
to go to one.
dialog.translation:
Si hubiera un colegio
aquí, me encantaría ir.

dialog.english:
S-School... That just brought up a
whole ton of bad memories...
dialog.translation:
C-Colegio... Eso me trae
un montón de malos
recuerdos...

dialog.english:
Be sure to work hard when you get
back!
Aha...
You can do it, Tai!

Guess I can't just secretly sneak
into your world, eh?
dialog.translation:
Supongo que no puedo
colarme en tu mundo, ¿eh?

dialog.english: Huh? Mimi? Where's Palmon?

I've been looking for her, but I
can't find her...
dialog.translation:
La he estado buscando, pero
no la encuentro...

dialog.english:
What?! Then we gotta go look for
her!
But Tai, you need to go soon!
It's okay, Tai.
Mimi...
Palmon...
Mimi...

Huh! I thought you'd be crying all
over the place, but you seem to be
doing okay.
dialog.translation:
¡Anda! Pensaba que estarías
llorando sin parar, pero
pareces estar bien.

dialog.english: Of course! I've gotten stronger.
Right?

Yeah... You did a great job
against Piemon!

Yeah! T.K and I have been
training hard, so there was no way
he could have won!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡T.K. y yo hemos estado
entrenando duro, así que no tenía
ninguna posibilidad!

dialog.english:
I'll have to make sure you two
don't beat me to it, either!
dialog.translation:
¡Tendré que asegurarme de
que no me superéis a mí
tampoco!

dialog.english: Oh, Tai!
Ahahaha!

Maybe I could go meet T.K if I
evolved...
dialog.translation:
Podría ir a ver a T.K.
si evoluciono...

dialog.english:
Are you done saying your goodbyes
to Joe?
dialog.translation:
¿Ya has terminado de
despedirte de Joe?

dialog.english: Yeah, I guess!

You don't really seem that worried
about Joe...
dialog.translation:
No pareces muy preocupado
por Joe...

dialog.english:
Well, yeah! I don't really have to
worry!

Joe's the kind of guy who'll pull
things off somehow!
dialog.translation:
¡Joe siempre se las
arregla de algún modo!

dialog.english: G-Gomamon!

Although it's hard to get him to
do anything unless you motivate
him.
dialog.translation:
Aunque cuesta que haga algo
si no le motivas un poco.

dialog.english: Hey!

Haha! You two are like a comedy
duo.

We'll meet again someday! So don't
forget to bring Joe with you!
dialog.translation:
¡Nos veremos algún día! ¡No
te olvides de traer a Joe!

dialog.english: Sure!
Not you too, Tai...
Take care of Joe, okay?

I won't be seeing you anymore, I
suppose.
dialog.translation:
Supongo que ya no te veré
más.

dialog.english:
Yeah. We didn't get to spend much
time together, but thanks.
dialog.translation:
Sí. No pasamos mucho
tiempo juntos, pero
gracias.

dialog.english:
I'm the one who should be thanking
you. Thanks for believing me, even
when I was your enemy.
dialog.translation:
Soy yo quien debería darte las
gracias. Por creer en mí, incluso
cuando era tu enemiga.

dialog.english: Well, Kari believed in you, too.
dialog.translation: Bueno, Kari también creyó en ti.

dialog.english:
You kept your promise. You said
you'd protect me...
dialog.translation:
Cumpliste tu promesa.
Dijiste que me
protegerías...

dialog.english:
Yeah. You're a really important
friend to us, Tailmon.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Eres una amiga muy
importante, Gatomon.

dialog.english: ...Thanks, Tai.

I have a lot of friends now, so I
don't need to worry anymore.
dialog.translation:
Ahora tengo muchos amigos
y ya no tengo que
preocuparme.
